description: The main goal of JUST DO IT! is to help users organize tasks efficiently. The app allows adding, removing, editing, and tracking daily activities, ensuring productivity and time management.
credits:
Developed by Issayeva Vera, Sailau Ayaulym, Turgimbayev Amirkhan within the course 'Crossplatform Development' at Astana IT University.
Mentor: Assistant Professor Abzal Kyzyrkanov
